messages:
Leo: Heads-up — scheduling X + LinkedIn posts for the Benchmark report + webinar next week. Need final copy + assets by EOD Thu. Can people confirm preferred slots? :calendar: 
Maya: I can get hero image + 3 quote cards. ETA Thu noon. Do we have a short video?
Sam: Working on copy. Two headline options for A/B testing. Drafts here: https://docs.redwood.internal/benchmark-social (comments welcome).
Sam: Suggested cadence:
- X thread (multi-tweet) -> Tue 09:00 PT
- LinkedIn post (single long-form) -> Tue 11:00 PT
- Reminder post -> Wed 12:00 PT
Anya: That timing should hit both east coast and EMEA late morning — good. I'll line up a short quote from the CEO for the LinkedIn post.
Hiro: For lead routing: make sure we use distinct UTM + form hidden field so it flows to the Benchmark campaign queue. Proposed UTM: `utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1`
Hiro: For routing rules: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1 -> segment "benchmark_webinar" -> assign to Hiro (demand). Can ops add that to the Zap/Segment mapping?
Maya: Assets needed: hero.png (1200x628), 3 quote cards (square), vertical 9:16 short for stories, and alt text for images. Also need final copy trimmed to 250 chars for LinkedIn preview.
Sam: Here are the two headline options (short):
A) "Cut inference cost by 3x — Redwood Benchmark"
B) "Faster LLM inference, lower unit cost — new benchmark"
Sam: I'll prepare an X thread that expands on the benchmark highlights and links to the webinar sign-up. Will include 1-2 data bullets + CTA.
Anya: Suggestion: pin PR-friendly stat in first tweet, attach quote card as image 1, then a short clip as tweet 2. Also PR will pitch journalists same day — keep embargo notes in the draft doc.
marketing-bot: Reminder: social publish approvals require at least one legal + one product ack before scheduling. Please add reactions :white_check_mark: once approved.
Leo: Can someone drop the final approved copy in this thread when ready? Also include preferred posting times in ISO (so the scheduler can accept).
Sam: Putting final copy in here for review: 
"Our benchmark shows optimized serving reduces per-token cost by up to 3x without quality loss. Join our live webinar to see configs, tricks, and real-world numbers. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar/benchmark"
Maya: Approved for visuals. Legal pls review copy for claims (3x). @legal-team can you sign off?
Hiro: On the routing side, please ensure the webinar sign-up form contains `source=social` and `campaign=benchmark_launch_v1`. We'll populate CRM mapping: 
```
if campaign == "benchmark_launch_v1":
  lead.owner = "Hiro"
  lead.queue = "benchmark_webinar"
```
Sam: For engagement follow-ups: plan a thread reply schedule — reply to top comments within 2 hours for first 6 hours. If >200 signups in first 24h, trigger SDR blitz.
Anya: Also ask community team to pin top insight and schedule an AMA the week after the webinar.
Leo: Sounds good. Quick checklist:
- [ ] Final copy (Sam)
- [ ] Hero + quote cards + short clip (Maya)
- [ ] Legal sign-off (legal-team)
- [ ] UTM + form field wired to routing (Hiro + Ops)
- [ ] Scheduler times in ISO (Sam)
- [ ] PR embargo notes (Anya)
Sam: I'll post ISO times when copy is finalized. Using internal scheduler syntax: 
```
post --channel x --time "2025-08-12T16:00:00Z" --text-file copy.txt --media hero.png --utm "benchmark_launch_v1"
```
Maya: Uploading assets to the doc now.
marketing-bot: Automated note: social queue capacity shows 2 open slots for Tue. Reserve via the console when ready.
Leo: Thanks everyone — drop approvals here and I’ll lock the schedule. :rocket:
